children: NextTrip launched NextTrip LIVE, a destination entertainment platform combining live music, creator marketing and its group travel booking tech.
NextTrip LIVE developed with YADA and Loaded Dice to merge live entertainment, creator-led engagement and travel booking.
Inaugural Destination Music Experience set for Nov 13–16, 2026 at Iberostar Selection Riviera Cancún featuring Yachty by Nature and Orlando Mendez.
Platform will leverage NextTrip Groups for reservations, room inventory, packages and fulfillment to enable repeatable events.
Company frames NextTrip LIVE as scalable content-to-commerce model to drive bookings, VIP experiences, sponsorships and media revenue.
